summary: Comprehensive testing of 5 bug fixes/features for Moneyssutra Personal Finance Tracker. All backend API tests passed (12/12). Frontend UI tests passed for core features.
critical_code_review_comments: Financial Health tooltip implementation is correct - uses inline display (mt-2 class) instead of position:absolute, preventing overlap onto adjacent cards
NotificationBell.js correctly checks relatedIncomeId before actionUrl to open IncomeAmountModal
SelfEmployedIncome.js has proper profession field loading logic with fallback for old entries
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 reported bugs/features have been verified as fixed. Financial Health Expand All/Collapse All button toggles correctly. Tooltips render inline (not overlapping). Reports page accessible at /insights/reports with PDF/Excel download. Self-employed profession field loads correctly on edit.

financial_health_expand_collapse.details: Expand All button expands all health cards and changes to 'Collapse All'. Collapse All collapses all cards and reverts to 'Expand All'.

financial_health_tooltip_inline.details: Code review confirms tooltip uses inline display (mt-2 class) within ValueBox, not position:absolute. This prevents tooltip from overlapping adjacent cards.

notification_view_income_modal.details: NotificationBell.js lines 108-127 correctly check relatedIncomeId first and open IncomeAmountModal when present, instead of navigating to income page.

self_employed_profession_field.details: Backend API returns profession field correctly. Frontend SelfEmployedIncome.js lines 127-155 have proper loading logic with fallback for known vs custom professions.

reports_page.details: Reports page accessible at /insights/reports with Report Settings (date range, PDF/Excel format), 7 report types with Download and Open links.

pdf_report_generation.details: GET /api/reports/generate/{type}?format=pdf returns valid PDF with content-type: application/pdf

excel_report_generation.details: GET /api/reports/generate/{type}?format=excel returns valid Excel file with spreadsheetml content-type

self_employed_income.get_shows_profession: PASSED - profession field returned in GET response

backend_tests_summary.notifications_api: PASSED - GET /api/notifications returns list, unread-count works

ui_tests_summary.dashboard_load: PASSED - Dashboard loads after login with loading spinner
ui_tests_summary.expand_all_button: PASSED - Button text changes from 'Expand All' to 'Collapse All' and back
ui_tests_summary.self_employed_page: PASSED - Profession picker visible with 'Select Profession' placeholder
ui_tests_summary.reports_page: PASSED - 7 Download PDF buttons, 7 Open links, PDF/Excel format toggle
ui_tests_summary.notification_drawer: PASSED - Opens with bell click, shows empty state correctly
